create_soft_rasterizer: create a SoftRasterizer instance with default 256x256 image size and black background
rasterize_mesh_forward: run the forward pass on a mesh object to render soft rasterized images
configure_distance_function: configure the SoftRasterizer to use euclidean, hard, or barycentric distance functions
enable_anti_aliasing: build a SoftRasterizer with anti-aliasing enabled that uses avg_pool2d for smoothing
customize_aggregation_functions: customize the SoftRasterizer softmax RGB and product alpha aggregation functions
